## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — no feature/fix
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] docs — docs only
- [ ] ci — CI/CD
- [ ] infra — Terraform/AWS
- [ ] security — security fix

## Checklist

### Code quality

- [ ] ESLint / Ruff pass
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or PII
- [ ] No debug `console.log` / `print` left in
- [ ] Types are accurate — no `any` / untyped

### Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] Coverage does not drop below 80%
- [ ] Error paths tested

### Security

- [ ] `pnpm audit` / `pip-audit` — no high CVEs
- [ ] Input validation on new endpoints
- [ ] Auth checked on new routes
- [ ] Gitleaks — no secrets committed

### Regulatory (tick if touching decisions or PII)

- [ ] Audit trail preserved
- [ ] GDPR Article 22 explainability unaffected
- [ ] EU AI Act model version in payload
- [ ] DORA evidence updated if incident-related

### Docs

- [ ] README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] OpenAPI spec updated if endpoints changed
- [ ] ADR written if architectural decision made
